pages.name: 首页
pages.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Color-design revision of the exact supplied desktop software screenshot; keep source crop, positions, component geometry, navigation, text content, icon, three original stickers (color and posture), and photos. Maintain the visual quality of a contemporary creative tool; no browser or device frame, no other screen. Full width custom title strip approx 57px tall. IMPORTANT: completely remove all blue and pale blue shell colors. Make the title strip a purposeful graphic composition with asymmetric modern diagonal-cut color fields: roughly two-thirds deep warm blackberry-plum (#452138) from the left, a large saturated tomato-vermilion (#DF503C) field toward the right with a small lime-paper (#D7E85B) geometric slash between them, and dark plum again behind the window controls at far right. These are large clean geometric fields, subtle paper texture only, no stock gradient, no empty white title bar. Keep white logotype “捞鱼创作台” and the existing app icon sharply readable on the solid dark zone at left; no big text across the graphic right. Around the main area, sidebar is warm mushroom linen (#EEE7DD) with charcoal text, no blue or violet cast. Main canvas warm cream (#F8F4EC), cards white-cream (#FFFCF7), typography ink (#2E2530), borders warm taupe gray. Strong well composed complementary clash, do not turn whole screen rainbow. Primary actions dark blackberry plum with white text; tomato highlights one or two landmarks; lime tinted selected chips use dark ink. Preserve a comfortable readable quiet workspace and photographic reference colors. Polished editorial graphic design, bold accent areas, modest rounding, no tiny decorative shapes behind text, no childlike excess. Chinese text exact and clear.
Revise the HOME reference: keep exactly two equal function cards and recent-project area. Color left function card distinct softly lavender-rose (#F0E4EC) with a bold blackberry heading “BGM 打标” and waveform in plum. Color right card distinct soft pale acid-lime (#EDF1C8) with tomato mini timeline mark and heading “AI 辅助剪辑”. Distinguish these two color-coded cards immediately. Left primary “进入工作区” plum with white; right same action as tomato red with dark text, or plum with white if needed for legibility. Preserve all 3 selected stickers with their original plaid, hair and eye colors, and show cream around their silhouette. Recent projects list stays warm neutral. Keep minimalist frame and selected “首页” with an acid lime tab on mushroom sidebar. It must look purposefully color-blocked with both playful stickers and readable UI.
